title: Russian Strike in Zhytomyr Strains Kyiv’s Power, Water Supply, Klitschko Says
summary: A Russian attack on an energy facility in Zhytomyr, western Ukraine, has reportedly worsened power supply to Kyiv and reduced water pressure in the capital, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Friday, Nov. 6. Kyivvodokanal is switching power to generators at its stations where possible, while repair crews assess the damage in Zhytomyr, according to Zhytomyr Regional Military Administration head Vitali Bunechko. The disruption comes amid a public dispute between Klitschko and President Volodymyr Zelensky over Kyiv’s winter readiness, and an earlier government warning that western Ukraine cannot expect to be spared in Russia’s strikes.

title: Investigation finds Russia’s billboards featuring troops fighting in Ukraine include men with criminal convictions and soldiers accused of war crimes
summary: Billboards featuring portraits of soldiers fighting in Russia’s war in Ukraine are a common sight in Russian cities. Their stories appear on the Russian Defense Ministry’s website — but the official biographies leave out some facts. The news outlet Bumaga identified 24 soldiers featured on billboards in St. Petersburg. They include soldiers killed at the front, former prisoners awarded the title of Hero of Russia, and suspected perpetrators of war crimes in Ukraine. Meduza is translating Bumaga’s full report on these men and other soldiers featured on the Defense Ministry’s website — more than 700 in all.

summary: Kyiv has delivered nearly 2,700 drones and 12 ground robotic systems (GRCs) to the 5th Separate Assault Brigade, the capital’s Mayor Vitali Klitschko said Friday, Nov. 6.
